text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At long last, Biwa Hayahide and I are<n>about to take
on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When Biwa Hayahide was little, she<n>panicked and
seriously injured<n>herself during a race when her
younger sister, Narita Brian, overtook<n>her. Stuck in a
hospital bed afterward,<n>she made a decision...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She vowed to develop an equation<n>that would allow
her to overcome<n>Narita Brian's raw talent so she
wouldn't lose the next time they<n>raced.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, my journey to develop a<n>winning equation
with Biwa Hayahide<n>begins.
